Stephanie / Sanjay — attaching suggested language and brief commentary. High-level position: we can agree to a narrow, opt-in publicity clause with an explicit embargo and approval step. We will not accept language that grants perpetual, unilateral publicity rights without consent.

Key proposed edits (summary):
- Replace broad clause with: "Customer and Redwood may jointly announce the relationship subject to Customer's prior written approval of the announcement copy and logos, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld. An embargo period of up to 45 days from the effective date may be requested by Customer for product launch coordination."
- Add a testimonial/quote approval step: Redwood will provide proposed testimonial text and Customer shall approve or reasonably request edits within 5 business days.
- Define "logo use": limited to announcement, case study, and customer list on Redwood's website; any other usage requires separate written permission.

I've put the full redline in the attached file (publicity_recommendations_rk.txt). One commercial note: if Novatech requires a hard prohibition on our inclusion in public customer lists for an extended period, we should capture that concession in the order form (e.g., reduced promotional credit). Ben — please advise on acceptable commercial offsets.
